"""Chạy trọn gói từ bất kỳ thư mục làm việc nào."""

from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
import sys


def main():
    # Windows redirected streams may default to cp1252.
    # Propagate UTF-8 to child scripts and benchmark subprocesses.
    os.environ["PYTHONIOENCODING"] = "utf-8"
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        if hasattr(stream, "reconfigure"):
            stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
    code = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    os.chdir(code)
    for script in [
        "TOAN_BO_MA_NGUON_PRJ35.py",
        "bo_sung_thuc_nghiem.py",
        "cap_nhat_dashboard.py",
    ]:
        print("Running:", script, flush=True)
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-u", str(code / script)], check=True)
    print("Completed all steps.", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
